sources.evidence_extract: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 dated 23JUN2022 states the single core applies to OPA197, OPA2197 and OPA4197. It models open-loop gain and phase with RL/CL effects, output impedance, settling, slew, capacitive-load overshoot and large-signal response. TI states the model is an aid, provided as-is. Copyrighted model bytes are retained in the ignored local cache; the URL and hashes enable verified reacquisition.
